tasks.label: Build Oscope (Mac)
tasks.command: xcodebuild -project Oscope.xcodeproj -scheme Oscope -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build build

tasks.label: Run Oscope (Mac)
tasks.command: xcodebuild -project Oscope.xcodeproj -scheme Oscope -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build build && open "${workspaceFolder}/build/Build/Products/Debug/Oscope.app"
